main_text.l: ANNO 1637. | Dies. | 5. SCHEBAT | Undecimus in anno sacro.
24 | 9 | | Die 5. moriuntur Seniores qui fuerunt aequales Iosuae filij Nun. Iud. 2.
7 | 23 | Iejunium. | Die 23. congregati sunt omnes Israelitae contra Benjamin. Iudicum 20.

page.notes: The table is a calendar of the Jewish month Schebat, with Gregorian dates in the left column. The right-hand column is set beside the table lines and is given here as printed notes.
